title: Info for Athletes — Boston Marathon
claims: Start times are 9:06 a.m. wheelchair men, 9:09 wheelchair women, 9:30 handcycles/duos, 9:37 pro men, 9:47 pro women, 9:50 para athletics, and 10:00, 10:15, 10:28, 10:41, 11:01 and 11:21 for Waves 1 through 6.
Official buses load on Charles Street between the Public Garden and Boston Common.
Official buses are for registered participants only and a bib must be shown.
Bus loading begins at 6:45 a.m. for Wave 1, 7:30 for Waves 2 and 3, 8:00 for Waves 4 and 5, and 9:00 for Wave 6.
Wave bib ranges are red 201–8199 (Wave 1), white 8200–11999 (Wave 2), blue 12000–15999 (Wave 3), yellow 16000–21299 (Wave 4), green 21300–26699 (Wave 5) and orange 26700–33699 (Wave 6).
Bus loading begins at 6:45 a.m. for Wave 1, 7:30 for Waves 2 and 3, 8:00 for Waves 4 and 5 and 9:00 for Wave 6, with a final bus at 9:30.
Gear check is on Boylston and Berkeley Streets beyond the finish line.
Gear check drop-off is 5:45 a.m. to 9:15 a.m. and pick-up is 11:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
Only the clear plastic B.A.A. gear bag is accepted, and no bags are transported from Hopkinton to Boston.
Clothing left in Hopkinton is donated to local organizations.
The Bank of America Expo is at the Hynes Convention Center, 900 Boylston Street, on Friday 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m., Saturday 9:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. and Sunday 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.
Bib pick-up requires a government-issued photo ID and the digital pick-up pass, and each runner must collect their own bib.
Entries are non-refundable, non-transferable and non-deferable except for deferrals under the pregnancy and postpartum policy.
